name: Broadband Anywhere
summary: Adelaide fixed-wireless + VoIP ISP (Broadband Anywhere Pty Ltd, ACN 113 946 213, Licensed Carrier 188, ~2004); defunct.

events.details: Fixed wireless + VoIP; Licensed Carrier 188. Earliest Wayback capture 3 Nov 2005 (broadbandanywhere.com.au); founding year approximate.
Retail homepage served content through ~Jul 2008; from Aug 2008 broadbandanywhere.com.au returned mostly 302 redirects (brief 200 revival Sep-Oct 2009), redirect-only through 2019. Defunct c. 2008.
source: Wayback CDX: 200 homepage through Jul 2008, 302 from Aug 2008
